metadata.title: The Saltglass Covenant
metadata.source_title: The Saltglass Covenant — original fixture story

adaptation.rights_basis: Original fixture story authored for this project

interpretation.summary: The tide was a common road until the levy syndicate began measuring it as property. Surveyor Iven watched the pumps at Knotmarket fail under a tariff nobody had voted for. The drowned registry held the last communal ledger. Mara, who mended pumps without asking a name, warned that the old metering warden still obeyed claims from a vanished age. Iven's lens could shift a little water, but each working blurred a memory. They would have to choose which debts a town ought to remember, and which gates it could afford to open.
interpretation.era: A coastal age of tidal engines and sail
interpretation.technology: Wind-driven boats, salt lenses and tide pumps
interpretation.supernatural_rules: Memories crystallize in salt; lenses redirect tides but erode the operator's recollections.
factions_and_cultures: No person may own a tide line.
Crews record debts in rope knots and settle disagreements at ebb tide.
interpretation.social_structures: A mutual-aid group challenges control of essential infrastructure.
interpretation.geography: tidal forest and fractured salt marsh
conflicts: Reopen the common sluice without handing its control to the levy syndicate.
relationships: The protagonist owes a practical debt to the guide; both need the residents' trust.
interpretation.narrative_structure: Discover the excluded, recover their record, then open the institution to shared control.
interpretation.danger: Ordinary enforcers teach tactics before a stronger guardian.
interpretation.morality: Care does not justify ownership of another life.

creative_direction.world_bible: The tide was a common road until the levy syndicate began measuring it as property. Mara, who mended pumps without asking a name, warned that the old metering warden still obeyed claims from a vanished age. Iven's lens could shift a little water, but each working blurred a memory. They would have to choose which debts a town ought to remember, and which gates it could afford to open.
creative_direction.gameplay_identity: Play a tide surveyor, recover contested records, use occupational tools or negotiate, and turn discoveries into institutional change.
creative_direction.originality_strategy: Independent original fixture story and cast; no external book adaptation.
creative_direction.main_narrative: Reopen the common sluice without handing its control to the levy syndicate.
side_narratives: Make discarded components useful to neighbors.
quality_criteria: Every quest changes a practical obligation
The final gate opens through shared knowledge, not arbitrary level gating

visual_style: Salt-dark map tiles, pale teal lenses, mustard quest compass; optional ASCII.
audio_direction: Short wooden clicks, low surf ambience, glass notes for discoveries.
